title: fix(studio): keep an unbound nav entry across a reload, marked incomplete; localize the publish sheet's type names and security rows
body:
Part of #32440

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 导航里“已添加但还没选目标”的导航项，刷新后不再消失，会在原位置显示并标「未完成」；发布面板里 mapping、seed 等类型名和发布前安全提示改为走控制台 i18n。
- 为什么改：作者加了导航项、没选目标就刷新，导航面板变成“还没有导航项”，变更徽标却还算着一份草稿；发布面板在中文界面里显示 `mapping 1`、`SEED 1` 和英文规则原文。
- 风险与回滚：服务端草稿仍然不含未完成项（规格拒收无目标的导航项），未完成项只保存在当前浏览器，换设备看不到；回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `withHeldNav` 与 `doNavSave` 里的 `writeHeldNav`（风险最高）；`AppNavCanvas.tsx` 的 `withHeldNavEntries`；`DraftChangesPanel.tsx` 的 `TYPE_COUNT` 与 `SECURITY_RULE_TEXT`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.navPlaceholderSave-11776.test.tsx`，预期 10 项全绿，其中三项是“刷新后仍在原位、标未完成”。
- 需要你做的：决定发布后提示（`saveAdvisoryToast.ts`）这一半怎么处理：它不在本单认领的文件面内，且该模块头部写明不翻译服务端规则文本；本 PR 因此用 `Part of`，卡保持打开。

## What changes

**Navigation editor (card item 2).** A nav entry added with the plus menu and not yet linked to a target is left out of what the nav save sends (`navPayloadOf`). That is still required: measured on the spec dist at the dispatch base, `AppSchema.safeParse` refuses `{ id: 'nav_item_1', type: 'object' }` with `navigation.0.objectName: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined`, and the save door judges the schema in draft mode as well as publish mode. So the entry cannot live in the app draft. It now lives in the editor layer:

- `heldNavEntriesOf` (in `AppNavCanvas.tsx`, beside `navPayloadOf`, reading the same `namesNoTarget` rule) lists every entry a save leaves out, at any depth, with its parent entry's `id` and its index.
- After each nav save lands, `doNavSave` stores that list in `localStorage` (`writeHeldNav`), keyed by the active organization, the package the save wrote to and the app. A save that leaves nothing out removes the key.
- When the app is read, the load installs `withHeldNav(body, …)` as the edit buffer: each held entry goes back into its parent's list at its index, unless the served navigation already has an entry with that `id` or the parent is gone. The baseline (`navBaselineRef`) stays the document as served. The *New dashboard / report / page* link path builds on the same buffer, so its save keeps holding them.
- The rail and the canvas mark such an entry with an "Incomplete" tag (zh 「未完成」, `engine.appNav.incomplete`), with a tooltip that says the item is kept in this browser and left out of the saved navigation (`engine.appNav.incompleteHint`). The mark reads `isIncompleteNavEntry`, which is the save's own rule, so the mark and the save cannot disagree.

Publishing never carries a held entry, because it is never in a draft. It stays in the editor, marked, until a target is picked (the next save sends it and the key goes) or it is removed.

**Publish sheet type names (card item 3).** `TYPE_COUNT` is still the only per-type table the sheet reads, now with rows for every type the spec registry marks `allowRuntimeCreate`: `mapping`, `seed`, `datasource`, `external_catalog`, `doc`, `book`, `position`, `tool` and `skill` join the existing rows, as count families in all eleven locale packs. A new pin holds the table to `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`, so a type added there later fails a test instead of showing its raw name. This table won over the designer's label table (`TYPE_LABELS_*` in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) for three reasons. That table carries no `seed` row and no plural forms. It is outside this card's file surface. And importing it would pull the Studio namespace into the sheet's eager console graph. No third table was added.

**Publish sheet security rows.** The pre-publish rows rendered `hint || message` as raw English. `SECURITY_RULE_TEXT` now keys a localized verdict by rule id for the four rules that can fire on the object drafts this sheet lints (`security-owd-unset`, `security-owd-alias`, `security-controlled-by-parent-no-relation`, `security-controlled-by-parent-ambiguous-relation`). Any other rule still reads its own text. The rule's own English message and hint stay on the row's `title`, because they name the exact value and remedy, which the generic verdict does not repeat.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not in this PR: the post-publish advisory toast.** The toast the card quotes (`[security-private-no-readscope] permission set …`) is the runtime authoring gate's server advisory, rendered by `providers/saveAdvisoryToast.ts`. That file is outside this claim's file surface, and its header records a deliberate choice to render server findings verbatim ("Why the finding text is not translated"). The rule is `info`-level, so the sheet's error-only rows never show it. That is why this PR says `Part of`.
- Held entries are per browser. Another browser or device shows the app as the server holds it. The keys go with `@object-ui/auth`'s signed-out and owner-change sweeps, which drop every key except a short allowlist.
- The draft the reload test reads is still counted under *Changes* when its navigation equals the published one. That was already true before this PR. The count is the server's draft ledger, and this PR does not touch it.
- `zh-Hant.ts` is generated from `zh-Hans.ts` (`gen:zh-hant`). The values there are the generator's output, not hand-written.

## Tests

- `AppNavCanvas.navPayload-11776.test.tsx`: new pins for `heldNavEntriesOf` / `withHeldNavEntries` round-trips, the refusals (an id already present, a missing parent), `isIncompleteNavEntry`, the storage round-trip and malformed values, and the canvas mark.
- `StudioDesignSurface.navPlaceholderSave-11776.test.tsx`: a reload before the target is picked shows the entry in its place, marked incomplete, while the server draft holds `NAV` only. A later *Add nav item* is numbered after it. Removing it after the reload drops the stored key. A control case shows a browser holding nothing reads the server's app. `localStorage` is cleared before each case.
- `DraftChangesPanel.summaryPlural-13147.test.tsx`: the registry-coverage pin; zh and en summary lines and group headings for `mapping` and `seed`; the zh security verdict with the rule's text on the tooltip.
- Updated: `StudioDesignSurface.railLabels.test.tsx` (the row's accessible name now ends in "Incomplete"), `StudioDesignSurface.navItemTypes-11790.test.tsx` (clears `localStorage` per case), and the three nav surface files import `@objectstack/lint` at module top, as `check:test-source-alias` prescribes.
- Ablation, one run, on the committed tree: the load's `setAppDraft(withHeldNav(body, navReadAt, name))` was replaced with `setAppDraft(body)` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob changed. Two reload pins went red and the other 8 cases stayed green. The script then restored the file: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
